detail.title: LapDesk25 Adjustable Laptop Table - Dark Brown
detail.overview: The Ant LapDesk25 is a portable lap desk with adjustable tilt, letting you lock the desktop at a comfortable slope for reading, writing or working on a laptop from bed, sofa or any flat surface. A simple two-side lock button mechanism lets you set and hold the desired angle securely, while multiple height positions add further flexibility to match different seating or reclining positions. Its compact, multi-functional design works equally well as a laptop workstation, breakfast tray or notebook computer stand, making it a versatile everyday accessory for anyone who works or studies away from a traditional desk, finished in a warm Dark Brown tone.
